novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a specific mechanism hypothesis: “a compact (k<=10), query-conditioned set of attention heads causally mediates whether an internally-recoverable fact is expressed,” with targeted manipulation reopening retrieval without changing storage. Searches using “LLM factual recall attention heads retrieval gate,” “hidden knowledge attention-head intervention,” and “query-conditioned factual retrieval routing” identify Geva et al., “Dissecting Recall of Factual Associations in Auto-Regressive Language Models,” as well as “Unveiling Factual Recall Behaviors of Large Language Models through Knowledge Neurons” (2024) and “Tracing and Dissecting How LLMs Recall Factual Knowledge for Real World Questions” (2025), which already describe attention-mediated attribute extraction, failures to harness stored facts, retrieval/reranking errors, and interventions that improve recall. Moving from those results to a compact, transferable gate specifically explaining internally decodable-but-unexpressed facts is a natural extension and non-trivial integration rather than a new core paradigm; the bounded head-set and hidden-versus-expressed causal relationship provide standard novelty beyond merely renaming attention routing.
